summary.text: The ancient Gu Immortal blessed land on San Cha mountain that the three kings remodelled into their inheritance grounds.

claims.text: The bronze hall is the only structure built in the blessed land’s important central area; it can be used to store things, but its defense is thin.
When the land is pierced, a grey plain appears like a foggy image separated by a veil, giving off a dream-like atmosphere.

In Shang Clan City, Fang Yuan sells intel to Wei Yang under a Grey Bone Scholar cover story from Bai Gu mountain. He states that the three kings inheritance ground now being explored is an ancient Gu Master’s blessed land, long degenerating and on the brink of collapse after the three kings emptied its treasures. He prices the report at four hundred thousand, and Shang Yan Fei later sends three exploration teams to San Cha mountain.

Deviation (recorded): this page uses the Southern Border region field because the entrance pillars and San Cha Mountain sit in that region. From chapter 346 onward the inheritance interior is a Gu Immortal blessed land small world, not a five-region seat in the main world.

The three kings inheritance was built inside a Gu Immortal blessed land, a small world within the main world. After failing to reach rank six, the three kings set their inheritances in that land before dying. Time there flows three times as fast as outside.

Tie Mu Bai says every blessed land faces earthly calamity every ten years and heavenly tribulation every hundred years. He names this land as originating from a mysterious Gu Immortal of ancient times, later inherited by the three kings and remodelled into the inheritance site. He judges it already old, near the end of its lifespan, and without a land spirit, lasting less than ten years before destruction from exhausted immortal essence.

Fang Yuan tells Ba Gui that the blessed land came from an ancient strength path Gu Immortal whose dying wish formed the land spirit, and that completing the wish means refining second aperture Gu. Narration states that three roaming kids used the land’s resources, became the three kings of the demonic path, failed to break through to rank six, and remodelled the place into the three kings inheritance. When the inheritance opened and immortal essence ran low, the huge tortoise Ba Gui awoke as the land neared ruin.

After taking Hu Immortal Blessed Land, Fang Yuan notes that Hu Immortal blessed land was not like the three kings blessed land on San Cha mountain. Hu Immortal land still had a land spirit, ample immortal essence, and Dang Hun Mountain as core protection.
Each green grape immortal essence pearl held much more immortal essence than the immortal essence in the three kings blessed land.
Fang Yuan counts Hu Immortal’s store at seventy-eight pieces and a half and calls that ample immortal essence a hundred times that of the three kings blessed land.

Bai Ning Bing recalls that shortly after Fang Yuan refined an Immortal Gu there, three kings blessed land collapsed, people fled San Cha mountain, and winds of assimilation wiped the mountain to barren land.
